name: @promptguard/mcp-server
stderr:
PromptGuard CLI not found.

  The MCP server is built into the PromptGuard CLI. Install it:

    macOS / Linux x86_64:
      curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/promptguardhq/promptguard-cli/main/install.sh | sh
    Windows and other platforms: download a binary from
      https://github.com/promptguardhq/promptguard-cli/releases/latest

  Then run again:
    npx @promptguard/mcp-server

  Docs: https://docs.promptguard.co/tools/mcp
